action:
After a standard system update anything that depends on libseccomp-golang
needs to be rebuilt to make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that libseccomp-golang incorrectly generated BPF filters
for rules that specified multiple syscall arguments, matching any one of
the arguments instead of all of them. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to bypass intended seccomp restrictions.
isummary: A system hardening measure could be bypassed.
title: libseccomp-golang vulnerability
